summary: setup.py for the habitat-hitl package. Contains internal helper functions (read, get_package_version) used only during package installation via setuptools. No importable CLI or callable APIs.
read_file_contents: read a file at the given path and return its contents as a string
get_package_version: get the package version by importing VERSION from habitat_hitl/version.py
install_habitat_hitl: install the habitat-hitl package using pip with dependencies from requirements.txt
setup_habitat_hitl_package: configure and build the habitat-hitl package with setuptools including all subpackages
review_setup_configuration: review the setup.py configuration for the habitat-hitl package including classifiers and dependencies
